name: Stratos Meridian Varsity
description:
Stratos is a mid-tier sportswear and lifestyle brand that sponsors several of GLMZ's professional athletic teams and semi-pro leagues. The Meridian Varsity is their flagship fan and player jacket — a classic varsity silhouette in boiled wool body with leather sleeves, ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and waistband, and snap-button front closure. The chest carries a large chenille patch of the wearer's affiliated team or district; the back is either blank or carries a name and number. Custom versions are available through Stratos retail kiosks at a modest upcharge.

This jacket crosses tiers in a way few garments do. Tier 1 kids save up for the cheapest version — wool-analog with synthetic sleeves, Φ45 at a grey-market kiosk. Tier 3 fans buy the genuine article. A Tier 4 exec might have a custom bespoke version made as a gift for their team after a playoff win. The varsity jacket is democratic in aspiration even if not in price. It says something about where you are from and what you belong to.
materials: boiled wool body (wool-analog in budget versions)
ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and waistband
what_it_says: You are from somewhere and you want people to know. You belong to something — a team, a district, a community — and the jacket is the proof.
story_hooks: A specific district's varsity jacket has been adopted as colors by a Shelf crew — wearing it in the wrong neighborhood has become dangerous in ways that have nothing to do with sports
A character is given a varsity jacket with a name and number that belongs to someone who died; the person who gave it to them wants that name to be seen in public
A limited run of Stratos Meridian Varsity jackets was made for a team that disbanded after a scandal; those jackets are now rare, sought-after, and complicated to wear

physical_description.visual_profile: Classic American varsity silhouette with a contemporary neo-noir edge—structured, athletic, instantly recognizable. The boiled wool body creates a substantial presence while leather sleeves add sharp contrast. Proportions are slightly cropped at the waist, emphasizing the torso. The ribbed knit trim at collar, cuffs, and waist creates clean lines and a tailored impression despite the relaxed athletic heritage.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the body with a subtle taper at the waist. Sleeves are fitted but not restrictive, allowing augmented limbs full range of motion. Length hits just below the hip. Designed for layering over light armor undergarments or data-mesh without bulk.
physical_description.primary_material: Boiled wool body (genuine or wool-analog depending on tier) with genuine or synthetic leather sleeves. The contrast between materials is intentional—wool provides insulation and water resistance, leather adds durability and aesthetic weight.
physical_description.texture: Boiled wool has a dense, almost felted quality with subtle horizontal grain. Leather sleeves range from buttery soft (Tier 1+) to slightly plastic-feeling (budget synthetics). Ribbed knit collar and cuffs have a tight, uniform texture with slight elasticity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Traditional varsity palette: typically solid wool body in black, charcoal, navy, or deep burgundy. Sleeves in contrasting black, brown, or oxblood leather. Ribbed trim matches sleeves or body. Large chenille team patch on chest in team colors—bright, saturated, impossible to ignore.
physical_description.closures: Snap-button front closure down the center—heavy-duty chrome or gunmetal snaps that feel substantial. Functional and iconic, echoing vintage design while being practical for quick augment access if needed.
distinctive_features: Large chenille team or district patch on left chest—textured, dimensional, clearly labeled with team identity
Optional back patch with wearer's name and number (custom order feature)
Ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and waistband in high-contrast color
Leather sleeves with subtle stitching along seams
Stratos brand tag visible at interior collar
Reinforced snap button placements to handle wear
Clean, minimal design with no excessive cybernetic modifications—retro-styled but modern in execution
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 aspirational (Φ45 grey-market wool-analog with synthetic sleeves) to Tier 3 standard (Φ120+ genuine boiled wool and leather) to Tier 4 custom bespoke. The jacket democratizes aspiration—entry-level versions accessible to working-class fans, premium versions attainable through savings or team loyalty programs.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals local pride and community belonging. Wearer is invested in GLMZ sports culture, team loyalty, or district identity. Not military, not corporate in the strict sense, but celebratory. A Tier 3 wearer shows they've earned enough disposable income for genuine goods. A Tier 1 wearer shows aspirational engagement. A Tier 4 executive wearing this signals humility and team connection rather than detached corpo status.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine on first wear, then quickly broken-in with character. Genuine wool/leather versions age beautifully—scuffs on sleeves from augment friction, slight wear at cuff edges, maybe a patch repair. Budget versions show creasing and synthetic sheen loss faster. Most wearers treat their varsity with care—it's an identity marker.
